_about: Regulatory updates found in PPWR Knowledgebase/ (2026). Each summary paraphrases the document named in 'source'. Impact / evidence-change text explains consequences for the TD evidence; it adds no requirement beyond the source.

updates.reference: Commission PPWR FAQ, 2nd edition (DG ENV, updated August 2026)
updates.title: Commission PPWR FAQ — 2nd edition
updates.title_zh: 欧盟委员会 PPWR 常见问题——第 2 版
updates.summary: Updates the March 2026 FAQ. Clarifies among others: the old PPWD harmonised standards (EN 13427-13432) can only be used as guidance — no presumption of conformity (except minimisation until end 2029); drawings and component materials must be in the manufacturer's TD; one DoC per packaging type, transport packaging included; Art 5(1) can be shown following EN 13428 Annex C.
updates.summary_zh: 更新 2026 年 3 月版 FAQ。主要澄清：原 PPWD 协调标准（EN 13427-13432）仅可作指引——不再产生符合性推定（最小化要求至 2029 年底除外）；图纸及组件材料须纳入制造商技术文档；每种包装类型一份 DoC，运输包装亦然；Art 5(1) 可参照 EN 13428 附录 C 证明。
updates.impact: Standards lists that claim 'presumption of conformity' for EN 13427-13432 must be corrected; projects relying on supplier-held drawings must obtain the drawings; transport units need their own DoC.
updates.impact_zh: 声称 EN 13427-13432 具有“符合性推定”的标准清单须更正；依赖供应商保存图纸的项目须取得图纸；运输单元须有各自的 DoC。
updates.evidence_change: C14-54 / C05-21: mark EN 13427-13432 as 'guidance'. C03-10 / C03-11: upload the drawings to the TD. C16-66: one DoC per packaging type.
updates.evidence_change_zh: C14-54 / C05-21：将 EN 13427-13432 标注为“指引”。C03-10 / C03-11：将图纸上传至技术文档。C16-66：每种包装类型一份 DoC。

updates.reference: C(2026) 2151 final — Annex: draft Commission Notice, Guidance document for Regulation (EU) 2025/40
updates.title: Commission guidance document on the PPWR approved
updates.title_zh: 欧盟委员会批准 PPWR 指南文件
updates.summary: The Commission approved a guidance notice interpreting selected PPWR provisions in reply to stakeholder questions, to support uniform application. Not legally binding.
updates.summary_zh: 委员会批准指南通知，针对利益相关方问题解释 PPWR 部分条款，以支持统一适用。不具法律约束力。
updates.impact: No new evidence requirement. Use it to interpret scope questions (who is the manufacturer, which packaging is in scope) before closing applicability decisions.
updates.impact_zh: 无新增证据要求。在确定适用性前，可用于解释范围问题（谁是制造商、哪些包装在范围内）。

updates.reference: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1425 of 30 June 2026 (OJ L, 3 Jul 2026)
updates.title: New rules for recycled plastic content in single-use beverage bottles (SUPD)
updates.title_zh: 一次性饮料瓶再生塑料含量新规则（SUPD）
updates.summary: Under Directive (EU) 2019/904: rules for calculating, verifying and reporting recycled plastic content in single-use plastic beverage bottles, introducing mass-balance accounting for recycling methods not covered by Regulation (EU) 2022/1616; repeals Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/2683.
updates.summary_zh: 依据 (EU) 2019/904 指令：规定一次性塑料饮料瓶再生塑料含量的计算、验证和报告规则，对 (EU) 2022/1616 未涵盖的回收方法引入质量平衡核算；废止 (EU) 2023/2683 实施决定。
updates.impact: Relevant only to single-use plastic beverage bottles (PPWR Art 7(1)(c) target 30 % from 2030). Recycled-content evidence for such bottles should state how the share was calculated (incl. mass balance).
updates.impact_zh: 仅涉及一次性塑料饮料瓶（PPWR Art 7(1)(c) 2030 年起 30% 目标）。此类瓶子的再生含量证据应说明比例的计算方法（含质量平衡）。
updates.evidence_change: C06-22 / C06-23 / C15-62 (beverage bottles only): ask the supplier for the calculation basis and chain-of-custody model.
updates.evidence_change_zh: C06-22 / C06-23 / C15-62（仅饮料瓶）：要求供应商提供计算依据及监管链模式。

updates.title: Corrigendum: annexes of Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1425 replaced
updates.title_zh: 勘误：(EU) 2026/1425 实施决定附件被替换
updates.summary: The annexes (formulas) are replaced: recycled content RC = R/W × 100 %, with bodies, caps/lids and labels/sleeves of PET bottles counted in both R and W, plus adjustments for exports and intra-EU movements.
updates.summary_zh: 附件（公式）被替换：再生含量 RC = R/W × 100%，PET 瓶的瓶身、瓶盖/盖子、标签/套标均计入 R 与 W，并对出口和欧盟内部流动作调整。
updates.impact: Calculations for PET beverage bottles must include caps and labels/sleeves.
updates.impact_zh: PET 饮料瓶的计算须包含瓶盖及标签/套标。
updates.evidence_change: C06-22: include cap and label masses in the recycled-content calculation for PET beverage bottles.
updates.evidence_change_zh: C06-22：PET 饮料瓶的再生含量计算须包含瓶盖和标签质量。

updates.source: 01_PPWR and related regulation and act/supplementing Regulation (EU) 2025 40 of the European Parliament .pdf
updates.title: Pallet wrappings and straps: exemption from the 100 % re-use requirement
updates.title_zh: 托盘缠绕膜和捆扎带：豁免 100% 重复使用要求
updates.summary: Delegated decision exempting certain economic operators using pallet wrappings and straps from the 100 % re-use requirement for those formats (re-use targets apply from 2030). Commission-adopted text; enters into force after OJ publication following scrutiny.
updates.summary_zh: 授权决定：豁免使用托盘缠绕膜和捆扎带的特定经济运营者对这些形式的 100% 重复使用要求（重复使用目标自 2030 年起适用）。为委员会通过文本；审查期后在官方公报公布方生效。
updates.impact: No change to the technical documentation of the packaging. Relevant to clients using transport packaging between their own sites (re-use obligations).
updates.impact_zh: 不影响包装的技术文档。与在自有场地之间使用运输包装的客户相关（重复使用义务）。

updates.reference: Call for evidence — two implementing acts and one delegated act under Art 7 PPWR (indicative Q4 2026)
updates.source: 03 under consultant-implemeting decision and act/Conditions for importing recycled materials into the EU for use in packaging.pdf
updates.title: Upcoming Art 7 acts: recycled-content calculation & verification, recycling-technology criteria, import conditions
updates.title_zh: 即将出台的 Art 7 法案：再生含量计算与验证、回收技术标准、进口条件
updates.summary: The Commission prepares the Art 7(8)-(10) acts: methodology for calculating and verifying recycled content and the TD format, sustainability criteria for plastic recycling technologies, and conditions for recyclates from third countries.
updates.summary_zh: 委员会正在起草 Art 7(8)-(10) 法案：再生含量计算与验证方法及技术文档格式、塑料回收技术可持续性标准，以及第三国再生料条件。
updates.impact: Once adopted, recycled-content evidence must follow the prescribed calculation, verification and TD format (Art 7(11): from 1 Jan 2029 or 24 months after adoption). Recycled content from non-EU recyclers will need equivalence proof.
updates.impact_zh: 通过后，再生含量证据须遵循规定的计算、验证与技术文档格式（Art 7(11)：2029-01-01 或通过后 24 个月起）。来自欧盟外回收商的再生料须提供等效性证明。
updates.evidence_change: C06-22 / C06-23 / C15-62: keep chain-of-custody certificates and recycler location now; expect to re-issue the calculation after adoption.
updates.evidence_change_zh: C06-22 / C06-23 / C15-62：现在即保存监管链证书及回收商所在地信息；预计法案通过后须重新出具计算。

updates.reference: PPWR substances-of-concern list — stakeholder consultation file (15 Jul 2026)
updates.title: Draft list of substances of concern in packaging (consultation)
updates.title_zh: 包装关注物质清单草案（征询意见）
updates.summary: Consultation spreadsheet of candidate substances of concern in packaging (CAS/EC, CLH/SVHC/POP status, effect on recycling, packaging material and function), feeding the Art 5(2) report due by 31 December 2026. No new limit value.
updates.summary_zh: 包装中候选关注物质的征询意见表（CAS/EC、CLH/SVHC/POP 状态、对回收的影响、包装材料及功能），服务于 2026-12-31 前完成的 Art 5(2) 报告。无新增限值。
updates.impact: Not binding. Signals which substances (e.g. in inks, coatings, adhesives) may be restricted later; full composition data lets you screen quickly when the list is final.
updates.impact_zh: 无约束力。提示哪些物质（如油墨、涂层、胶黏剂中的）日后可能受限；完整成分数据便于清单定稿后快速筛查。
updates.evidence_change: Recommended: ask suppliers for full composition with CAS numbers (C02-08, C02-09, C15-58, C15-64).
updates.evidence_change_zh: 建议：要求供应商提供含 CAS 号的完整成分（C02-08、C02-09、C15-58、C15-64）。

updates.reference: EUROPEN FAQ on Conformity Assessment under Regulation (EU) 2025/40 (August 2026)
updates.title: Industry FAQ on PPWR conformity assessment (updated)
updates.title_zh: 行业 PPWR 合格评定 FAQ（更新）
updates.summary: Industry association answers on the content, format and obligations of conformity assessment for Art 5-12. Explicitly not legal advice and without prejudice to Commission interpretation.
updates.summary_zh: 行业协会关于 Art 5-12 合格评定内容、格式与义务的解答。明确声明不构成法律意见，不影响委员会解释。
updates.impact: Practical reading for TD structure; no change to legal requirements.
updates.impact_zh: 可作为技术文档结构的实务参考；不改变法定要求。
